items.summary_en: Cohere has released Parse 5, a proprietary 2.3B-parameter multimodal vision-language model that converts complex PDFs such as financial reports and scientific papers into clean Markdown and emits bounding-box coordinates, replacing brittle OCR pipelines. It scored 79.2 on the ParseBench benchmark, beating Mistral OCR and Google Gemini 3 Flash, and could slash failures in high-throughput enterprise document extraction.

Even with a global proxy the issue persists, suggesting Apple has added geo-restrictions to non-China models; the wloc coordinate workaround from iOS 27 beta 6 is also broken.

items.summary_en: Arm has unveiled Neoverse CSS N4, a compute subsystem for chipmakers rather than a finished server CPU. A single die can be configured with 8 to 128 cores at up to 3.8GHz and adds the first support for LPDDR6 and PCIe 7.0 in the N-series CSS lineup. Arm claims up to 2x single-socket performance, 25% better performance-per-watt, and 75% higher memory bandwidth versus N3, targeting DPUs, network chips, and agent-sandbox isolation workloads.

items.summary_en: On June 23, 2026, Anthropic released Claude Tag (beta) for Claude Enterprise and Team; admins can place it in channels so members @Claude and assign tasks spanning tools, data, or codebases, with shared memory. Because Enterprise plans are expensive and teams may not use Claude, the author open-sourced AgentConnect as an alternative that connects Claude, Codex, or Hermes to Feishu, WeChat, Discord, GitHub code review, or webhooks. Its key difference is permission by construction: the agent process has no production credentials and its token lacks write access.

items.summary_en: This InfoQ article explains HCF, a holographic coding framework that shifts monitoring from “what each component is doing” to “how components cooperate.” Signals become a conflict graph, an I-value, and structured diagnostic codes. In RCAEval's 202 fault injections it caught all 177 observable faults (100%) and alerted about 20 minutes earlier on average. It's aimed at on-call engineers fighting alert storms.

items.summary_en: Cube Sandbox v0.7.0 is out. Sandbox memory and filesystem state now go to S3, so a sandbox paused on node A can resume on node B, and the same snapshot can spawn new sandboxes on any synced node. This decouples sandbox state from individual hosts, easing node draining and scheduling. The release also supports multi-version runtime components, keeping old templates and snapshots valid after cluster upgrades. Kubernetes-based Agent sandbox teams should explore it.

items.summary_en: At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon China 2026, China Merchants Bank won the CNCF end-user case study competition. It built a unified control plane on Kubernetes with Kueue, KEDA, HAMi, Fluid, and Prometheus, letting model training, fine-tuning, and online inference share nearly 10,000 heterogeneous accelerators, covering 99% of its AI compute. Reported results: average accelerator utilization rose from 35% to above 60%, and inference cost per million tokens fell by more than 60%.

items.summary_zh: OpenMarket 是一个多智能体市场，核心规则是“证明说了算”：智能体用可验证的证据竞争，而非靠名气或投票。目前只有这一句简介，没有给出实现细节或案例；关注 Agent 验证机制的开发者可以留意。

So far only this one-line description is available, with no technical details or examples. Developers interested in agent trust and proof-based competition may want to follow it.

items.summary_en: Scriptly, currently listed on Product Hunt, is an iOS teleprompter app whose key feature is voice control: instead of tapping the screen or using a separate remote controller, the user advances the script by voice. That convenience targets people creating videos or speaking publicly and needing hands-free prompting. The Product Hunt entry only gives that description, with no further details about the app's interface or integrations.

items.title: Keep Our Servers Running

items.summary_zh: 互联网档案馆（Internet Archive）九月发起“让服务器继续运行”的募捐：这一期间，用户设置的经常性捐款会按 3 倍计入，用于服务器、存储、供电、冷却和运维人力等支出。该馆说明其服务始终免费、不会出售用户数据或投放广告，因此本次资助对基础设施维续很重要。
items.summary_en: The Internet Archive is running a September 'Keep Our Servers Running' campaign, saying recurring donations will be counted 3x to pay for servers, storage, power, cooling and staff. The Archive stresses it stays free, never sells user data and runs no ads, making this infrastructure campaign key to keeping its public services alive.

It is designed for people who want notes to remain visible while an AI is available right where they work. The listing doesn't give further detail on the agent's abilities.

items.summary_en: At the JDD conference on Sept 9, JD Logistics unveiled five new 'Wolf Pack' robots covering warehousing, cold chain, and fulfillment. One highlight, Cang Wolf, deploys in two weeks and picks with 99.9% accuracy. In the next five years, it plans to procure 3 million robots, 1 million unmanned vehicles, and 100,000 drones to further automate supply-chain operations.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
items.author: cathrynlavery

items.summary_en: cathrynlavery/diagram-design is a library of 39 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and other agent-compatible hosts. It generates self-contained HTML + SVG instead of Mermaid, with semantic patterns separating behavior from layout. Version 2.5.10 adds ten layout grammars, including Sankey, Wardley map, UML class, and database schema. Developers who want agent-generated visuals that look finished rather than generic Mermaid output should check it.

items.title: Shopify 推出 Gisting 新技术：将大模型系统提示词压缩为主旨词元
items.summary_zh: Shopify 工程团队推出 Gisting，将冗长 LLM 系统提示词压缩为学到的 Gist 词元，且无需修改模型权重。用于 Sidekick GraphQL 智能体后，系统提示词从约 6000 词元降至 1500 词元，350 RPM 下 TTFT 中位延迟从 438ms 降至 354ms，端到端延迟从 6.8s 降至 4.2s，QPS 从 20.2 提升到 23.4。该技术源自 2022 年论文，可与前缀缓存叠加，适合需要优化 LLM 推理延迟与成本的团队。
items.summary_en: Shopify introduced Gisting, which compresses long LLM system prompts into learned Gist tokens without modifying model weights. For the Sidekick GraphQL agent, it reduced a system prompt from roughly 6,000 to 1,500 tokens; at 350 RPM median TTFT dropped from 438ms to 354ms, end-to-end latency from 6.8s to 4.2s, and throughput rose from 20.2 to 23.4 QPS. Based on a 2022 paper, the technique complements prefix caching, making it useful for teams cutting inference latency and cost.

items.title: 70%的项目注定被砍：Anthropic养了一支20人的“失败团队”，项目超过4人就“毕业”
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 内部约 20 人的 Labs 团队由联合创始人 Ben Mann 领导，Claude Code、MCP、Claude Design 都出自这里或曾在此早期孵化，但创意成功率仅约 20%-30%。项目约每两周评审一次，规模超过 4 人即“毕业”为独立产品团队，失败项目则被砍掉或合并；这套高流动模式参考了 Bell Labs 和 Google Area 120/X。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Labs is a roughly 20-person incubator led by cofounder Ben Mann. Claude Code, MCP, and Claude Design were incubated or early-stage here, yet success rates for ideas are around 20-30%. Projects are re-evaluated about every two weeks; once a team exceeds four people it graduates into a full product group, while failing bets are killed or merged—a fluid model inspired by Bell Labs and Google’s Area 120/X.

items.title: 百度把Agent推进家庭：百度搭子接入小度，从“管家”走向“办事”和“创造”
items.summary_zh: 9 月 8 日，小度宣布“超能小度”完成智能体化升级，百度搭子全面接入小度硬件，并推出家庭日程、儿童看护、长辈健康等家庭智能体和四款新品。百度搭子负责任务理解、规划与调度，小度负责落地家庭场景；用户还能用一句话生成自己的家庭应用。百度搭子 7 月月活达 674.3 万，环比增长 1063.79%，Agent 正在从桌面/个人场景走向家庭生活服务。
items.summary_en: On Sept 8, Xiaodu said its “Super Xiaodu” assistant completed an upgrade into an agentic system: Baidu Dazi is now connected across Xiaodu hardware, joined by household agents for schedules, childcare, and senior health plus four new devices. Dazi handles task understanding, planning, and dispatch; Xiaodu fits those capabilities to family devices, and users can create household apps with natural-language instructions. Dazi reached 6.743M MAU in July (+1063.79% MoM), underlining Baidu’s move of agents from desktop/personal use into homes.

items.title: Claude, change the “Add to Cart” button to blue

items.summary_en: A short interactive comedy: the user tells Claude to make the Add to Cart button blue and change nothing else, dramatizing how agentic AI assistants can never just perform one simple instruction. It is not a technical tutorial but a parody of AI agents over-acting or going off the rails during code/product changes—immediately familiar to developers who have seen an agent turn a tiny edit into a mess.

items.summary_en: The list picks 10 top trending GitHub projects for May 2026 out of 17 candidates, including skills, codegraph, Understand-Anything, and Pixelle-Video. The common thread is moving agents from one-off chats to reusable, collaborative, deliverable engineering workflows—saving tokens, retaining context, orchestrating multiple agents, and generating content. With over 65,000 new stars in May, skills was the fastest-growing project, while codegraph pre-indexes code locally to cut token and tool-call costs in large repos.

items.summary_zh: 文章用 Three.js 实现了一个简易版电影《牛来》的效果，并附上完整代码和演示效果。作者提到这部据传仅两人主创的电影因“土到极致就是潮”而走红；适合想借热点练习 Three.js 动画的开发者。
items.summary_en: This post builds a simplified Three.js version of the viral Chinese movie Niu Lai, with the full source code and a demo. The author notes the film is reportedly created by just two people and became popular for its proudly cheesy aesthetics. It's a good starting point for developers learning Three.js through a trending cultural reference.

items.title: 👉 尤雨溪再次成立新公司，同时官宣 Pinia 4 正式发布！
items.description: 尤雨溪出席了 Vue 大会，透露自己成立了新公司 Vue 源码有限公司，用来赞助 Vue 的全职开源成员。此外，它还分享了 Pinia 4 主版本升级，现在只支持 ESM 模块，安装体积大幅缩减。
items.summary_zh: 尤雨溪在 Vue 大会上宣布成立 Vue 源码有限公司，用于资助 Vue 的全职开源成员；同时发布 Pinia 4 主版本，仅支持 ESM 模块，安装体积大幅缩减。Vue 生态开发者需要适配 Pinia 4 的 ESM-only 约束，并了解依赖体积的变化。
items.summary_en: At the Vue conference, You Yuxi announced a new company, Vue Source Co., Ltd., set up to sponsor full-time open-source contributors working on Vue. He also unveiled the Pinia 4 major release, which now supports only ESM modules and shrinks the installed package size significantly. Vue developers should account for the ESM-only constraint.

items.title: 为什么跳槽涨薪 30% 的时代彻底结束了？聊聊 2026 前端薪资的天花板
items.description: 前端薪资红利期结束，供需失衡与AI工具普及压缩执行层价值。高薪转向决策层，需具备成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力。
items.summary_zh: 文章称，前端跳槽涨薪 30% 的红利期已结束，2026 年薪资天花板受到人才供需失衡和 AI 工具普及的双重挤压，执行层价值被压低。高薪机会转向决策层，需要能承担成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力的工程师。适合想评估前端职业空间和技术栈方向的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The article argues that the era of 30 percent pay raises from job-hopping is over for front-end developers; by 2026 the salary ceiling is squeezed by supply-demand imbalance and AI tools that devalue execution-focused work. Higher-paying roles now go to decision-level engineers who can handle cost optimization, standards, or full-stack work. Good context for developers mapping their front-end career options.

items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍 Pi——一个运行在 CLI 中的 Coding Agent，并分享将它与 DeepSeek-v4-Flash 组合使用的体验。作者 cxuan 称其用起来很顺手，适合喜欢在终端里完成编码任务的开发者。文章聚焦实践感受而非详细教程。
items.summary_en: This article introduces Pi, a coding agent that runs in the CLI, and shares hands-on experience pairing it with DeepSeek-v4-Flash. It targets developers who prefer terminal-based coding workflows and provides practical impressions rather than a full setup guide.

items.summary_zh: 前端开发者“小张同学”结合近期每天用 AI 写代码的体验，分享了一套 AI 全栈开发实践，并坦言手写代码能力已经明显下降。他认为按当前节奏，AI 编写代码会在更多场景替代人工。适合正在搭建 AI 辅助编程流程的开发者参考，也提醒自己别丢掉基本功。
items.summary_en: A front-end developer who goes by “小张同学” shares full-stack development practices built around writing code with AI every day. He admits his hand-coding ability has dropped noticeably and argues AI-generated code will keep replacing manual work in more scenarios. The post is useful for developers building AI-assisted workflows and doubles as a warning about foundational-skills atrophy.
